versions.description: Kicks players who join the server for the first time with a character above a level limit, and can ping a Discord role about it. Every hour it saves the level of each online regular player; the limit is the average of the three highest saved levels, never below the configured level. Players it kicks, and players an admin lets in, never count toward the limit. Kicked players are kicked again on each join until they come back with a character within the limit or an admin runs levelallow. Needs the Takaro Enshrouded connector with character levels (console commands 'level' and 'levels'). Tip: set the CheckLevelOnJoin hook delay to 15 seconds so the character has loaded.

commands.name: levelallow
commands.helpText: Let a player in that the level guard blocked.

hooks.name: CheckLevelOnJoin
hooks.description: Kicks a player new to this server whose character is above the level limit. A kicked player gets in again with a character within the limit, or after levelallow.

cronJobs.name: UpdateLevelLimit
cronJobs.description: Every hour: saves the level of each online regular player, then sets the limit for new players to the average of the three highest saved levels (never below the configured level).

permissions.description: Can let a blocked high-level player in with levelallow.
